# Online Degree Tuition 2026

> Open dataset: 740 online degree programs at 537 US institutions, tuition
> verified against each university's official website.
> By Study Intelligence (https://aclas.si). License: CC-BY-4.0.
> Snapshot: 2026-10-15.

## What question does this answer?

What does an online degree actually cost in the US in 2026? Every figure
traces to an official source URL.

## Coverage

- Online MBA: 228 programs
- Online DBA: 38 programs
- Business bachelor's: 299 programs
- Online BSCS: 67 programs
- Online MCS: 108 programs

## Files

- `online-degree-tuition-2026.csv` — 740 rows (UTF-8)
- `online-degree-tuition-2026.json` — same data plus metadata
- `CITATION.cff` — machine-readable citation

## Columns (CSV)

`school`, `program`, `level` (mba / dba / bachelor / bscs / mcs),
`tuition_usd` (total program tuition, USD), `tuition_note`, `estimate`
(true = computed from per-credit x credits, not a quoted total),
`accreditation`, `format`, `source_url`, `verified` (date checked).

## Caveats

- 439 rows are estimates (per-credit x required credits); treat as
  comparisons, not quotes. Basis is in `tuition_note`.

## Citation

Study Intelligence (https://aclas.si). "Online Degree Tuition 2026"
(v1.0.0, 2026-10-15). CC-BY-4.0.
